_comment: Steps 4-6 spec (docs/02_hypothesis.md Deviation 5). Written before any direction, dev pass or test run. Dev grid and steering values are fixed here, before any dev evaluation.
_batch_note: One batch size for every pass in Steps 4-6 (direction, dev incl. a fresh C0 dev pass, test), so greedy outputs are comparable across conditions. Pilot 2 used 16.

direction.activation: residual stream after decoder layer l (hidden_states[l+1]); per-response mean over in-loop tokens minus mean over pre-onset response tokens; averaged over responses; normalized per layer

dev.prompts: first 40 of data/sv_open_dev.jsonl and data/en_open_dev.jsonl (same items as pilots)

default_config.name: default
default_config._source: paper p50c placement copied (Deviation 5, item 5); zero feedback passes

dev._top2: the two layers in layer_choice_range with the largest separation (mean / std of per-response projected difference) in Step 4
dev._steering: C2: at the selected config's layers, h <- h - alpha_s * (h . u_l) u_l at every position (forward hook on the decoder layer output). alpha_s picked on dev with the same rule.
dev.selection_rule: lowest sv_open loop rate, subject to (a) en_open loop rate <= C0 dev, (b) early-stop check passes; ties -> smaller Frobenius norm of the weight change
dev.fallback_if_none_pass: the passing-early-stop config with the lowest sv_open loop rate; if none passes early-stop, the default config. Either case is flagged in frozen.json.
dev.early_stop_check: share of responses < 30 new tokens rises by <= 10 points vs baseline on sv_open and on en_open, and en_open median length within 30% of baseline

test._order: priority order; each cell is saved when done; a re-run skips finished cells; the runner stops before a new cell after the deadline
